_comment: AAI live-status dashboard tap overlay (SPEC-0114-spec-live-status-dashboard). OPT-IN: nothing installs this automatically — merge the 'statusLine' key and the 'Stop'/'Notification' hooks below into the project's .claude/settings.json (existing settings are merged additively, never overwritten). Wires the Claude Code statusLine and the Stop/Notification hooks to live-spool.sh, which appends a WHITELISTED projection of the harness's own stdin payload to docs/ai/live/{statusline,hooks}.jsonl — never message or transcript content. Absence of this overlay leaves the dashboard's liveness section on its mtime heuristic fallback and the quotas section on its named SKIP; both are honest, tested paths, not broken ones. The writer always exits 0 so a spool failure never disturbs the harness. Uninstall: remove the 'statusLine' key and the two hook entries below from .claude/settings.json (or delete docs/ai/live/ to reset the spools without uninstalling).
